note: What a server sends to put a minion-like unit on the field, such as a ward. The header names the unit that put it there.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The name the new unit answers to.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the unit belongs to.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where it stands, in height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look it wears.

fields.name: clone
fields.note: The unit it copies, or zero.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: team
bits.note: Which side, as a team number.

bits.name: ignoreCollision
bits.note: Set where it does not block the way.

bits.name: ward
bits.note: Set where it is a ward.

bits.name: laneMinion
bits.note: Set where it is a lane minion.

bits.name: bot
bits.note: Set where it is driven by the client's own decisions.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.note: What sort of unit it is.

fields.name: targetableToTeam
fields.note: Which sides can aim at it, as a set of bits.

fields.name: visibilitySize
fields.note: How large it counts as for sight, in world units.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Its name, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art under, padded with zero bytes.

revisions.note: A client deletes any object holding the new unit's id first, and does nothing more where it cannot make the unit. owner is only who gets the gold the unit earns; clone, where nonzero, is copied, state and inventory; onlyVisibleTo, zero or unknown, restricts nothing.
